scope: RB1 release-bound scientific traceability population only

items.rationale: The registry points to the one frozen RB1 scientific source authority and creates no alternate kernel.
Only documentation and qualification metadata are added; kernel I/O boundaries are unchanged.
No runtime data categories change; the traceability index only documents existing release capabilities.
No persistent column state is added or reclassified.
No worker scratch or solver temporary ownership changes.
No memory layout, batching, pooling or execution-class storage changes.
RB1 transactional qualification is referenced at T11/T13 without altering checkpoint, trial, commit or rollback semantics.
No recomputation or warm-start behaviour is changed; restart and temporal evidence remain pinned to their qualified authorities.
RB1-CORE-INTERVAL remains explicitly generic [t0,t1]; documentation introduces no calendar unit assumption.
No coupling-window duration or schedule is introduced.
Coupling remains outside RB1 required production scope where not qualified and is not silently claimed by the traceability index.
No groundwater-interface accuracy claim is introduced; universal MODFLOW accuracy remains an RB1 nonclaim.
Hard mass qualification is referenced but never weakened; F-DOC02 has no mechanism to relax mass conservation.
No interface sensitivity contract is modified or reinterpreted.
No coupling production path or run-count policy is changed.
Standalone and MultiSWAP release capabilities remain explicitly separate entries on the same RB1 source authority.
No one-to-one MODFLOW mapping assumption is added.
Deep-vadose remains outside RB1 and outside this documentation population workunit.
No component transition or water-storage accounting is changed.
RossFast and alternative production solvers remain nonclaims; the index does not elevate them into RB1.
Existing qualified SWAP physics is referenced by immutable evidence; missing theory tiers remain gaps rather than being reconstructed from legacy code.
T10 implementation mappings remain explicit gaps until exact public-contract/code mappings are populated; no HeadCalc internals are exposed as cross-module contracts.
Physical capability scope and numerical qualification evidence remain separate dimensions.
Surface-evaporation throughput/scaling remains explicitly outside the scientific/canonical claim and is not inferred from local performance admission.
Full Richards REFERENCE authority remains pinned and RossFast is not promoted.
Diagnostics are indexed as a qualified release capability; no new runtime state is introduced.
Documentation metadata adds no runtime cost to optional physics or individual columns.
Runtime/coupler system composition remains outside the kernel and outside the F-DOC02 release index.
The index is exact-authority bound and introduces no hidden assumptions about files, days, start times or MODFLOW attachment.
F-DOC02 is explicitly audited here against all 30 SWAP core architecture invariants before qualification.
